purpose: Correct only Data materialization order after retained attempt-45 proved that reset-triggering scene reconstruction deletes a pre-populated copied cache.

onlyAllowedCorrection.before: The exact copied Data occupied the final cache directory while reset-triggering scene properties were reconstructed and the directory was rebound.
onlyAllowedCorrection.after: Keep exact Data in a separately verified staging directory; reconstruct all scene properties and bind an empty final cache directory first; then copy the 14 files into the final directory, verify exact manifest, set has_cache_baked_data=true and save.
onlyAllowedCorrection.unchanged: Binary, source blend, physical settings, Data bytes, Mesh settings, two starts, one adoption, zero Data bakes, one Mesh bake, two saves, thresholds and resource limits.

stopRule: Use unique fresh attempt-46 roots once; stop on staged/final/retained Data drift, a non-empty final cache before materialization, unwritable or unpersisted baked state, any Data bake, process/roster/scientific/resource/symlink/media failure, or any change beyond materialization order.
claimCeiling: One C3 cross-process cache materialization and Mesh-only reconstruction from accepted Final Data. A PASS proves exact reuse and static seven-frame thresholds only; it does not prove general cache import safety, slow tip, impact, lighting, camera or finished-film quality.
